# Hi, I'm Maria Camila

I'm a mathematics student with interests in data analysis, research, and problem-solving.

I enjoy using quantitative methods to explore complex questions, identify patterns, and turn data into meaningful insights. My academic and professional experiences span mathematical modeling, public policy, community engagement, and applied research.

Through this portfolio, I share projects that demonstrate how I approach problems, work with data, and communicate findings across different fields.

## A Little About Me

Chicago has always been home, and growing up here has given me a real appreciation for the city, its neighborhoods, and the communities that make each one unique. As a Colombian-American, I also value the different cultures and perspectives that shape the places around us, which is something that has naturally influenced my interest in community and public policy.

Outside of work and school, I spend a lot of my free time on puzzles, especially GeoGuessr and, lately, puzzles from the Magic Puzzle Company. I’m also a big coffee person and always appreciate finding a good coffee shop around the city.
